mode.title: Query Mode
mode.description: Fetch all active severe weather warnings across Brazil, filter by state (UF), or filter by municipality / IBGE code.

uf.title: State Acronym (UF)
uf.description: Optional 2-letter Brazilian state code (e.g. SP, RS, AL, MT, BA) for alerts_by_state.

query.title: Municipality or Hazard Keyword
query.description: Optional case-insensitive municipality name, weather hazard (e.g. Tempestade, Chuvas Intensas), or keyword.

ibgeCode.title: 7-Digit IBGE Municipality Code
ibgeCode.description: Optional exact 7-digit IBGE city code (e.g. 2704302 for Maceio, 3550308 for Sao Paulo).

severityFilter.title: Severity Level Filter
severityFilter.description: Optional severity filter: all, Perigo Potencial, Perigo, or Grande Perigo.

includePolygons.title: Include GeoJSON Alert Polygon
includePolygons.description: Include parsed GeoJSON geometry polygon for spatial intersection workflows.

includeAllMunicipalities.title: Include Full Municipality List
includeAllMunicipalities.description: Include full list of affected municipality names instead of sample + matches.

timeoutSecs.title: Request Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when polling INMET.
